_about: Refinements of SPEC Appendix G drawings at 16 px (SPEC 30.1: implement them faithfully, refine proportions at 16 px, keep the concepts). tools/extract-icons.mjs lays these over the spec's drawings; each says why.

surprised.why: Its burst's nine shallow points read as a cog at 16 px (critic P7 r1): seven deep points, the exclamation mark bolder.

deathsaves.why: Its crack stopped short of the outline, so at 16 px it differed from Charmed by a few inner pixels (critic P7 r1): a filled heart broken in two along the crack, the halves apart.
